description: Send an EVM transaction via the connected WalletConnect wallet. The wallet will prompt the user to approve and sign. By default this waits for the on-chain receipt and returns the settled result (confirmed/reverted, block number, gas used). Set wait=false to return immediately with just the transaction hash. Requires an active session — call connect first.

chain.description: Target chain as a CAIP-2 id ("eip155:11155111") or numeric chain id. REQUIRED — there is no default chain; pick one of the granted chains from status.

data.description: Hex-encoded calldata (e.g. "0x" for plain ETH transfer). Omit for plain transfer.

from.description: Sender address. Defaults to the connected wallet address if omitted.

timeout_ms.description: Max ms to wait for the receipt (default 120000). Ignored when wait=false.

value.description: Value in wei as a hex string (e.g. "0x38D7EA4C68000" for 0.001 ETH). Omit for 0.

wait.description: Wait for the receipt and return the settled result. Default true.

name: send_transaction
title: Send transaction
